error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If x^2 is combined with x terms, the issue is treating unlike powers as the same kind of term. Middle-term work in expansion needs this separation.

hint_ladder.title: Unlike powers
hint_ladder.prompt: x^2 and x are not like terms because their powers are different.

hint_ladder.title: Collect x only
hint_ladder.prompt: Combine 3x and 2x first. Leave x^2 as its own term.

hint_ladder.title: Power slip
hint_ladder.prompt: A common move to check is merging the squared term with the first-power x terms. Keep different powers in separate groups.

hint_ladder.title: Power-check routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Before collecting, compare both the variable and the power. Only exact matches combine; use that here and do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on leaving x squared separate while collecting only the first-power x terms.
